text:
maria: Customer (AcmeCorp) asked if we can accept 'evidence ingest' for SOC2: they want to push audit artifacts (logs, CSVs, PDF evidence) into our platform and have them retained/ searchable for audit. Questions: API contract, retention SLAs, BYOK/KMS implications. Any immediate blockers?

sam: What's the expected retention window? 1y/3y/7y makes a big difference for storage + index cost.

amy: Legal: for SOC2 evidence we need chain-of-custody language + exportability. Also need to confirm rights to store customer-supplied PII — contract alt needed.

kai: BYOK note: if they require customer-managed keys we must support envelope encryption with customer KEK. Handshake UX: KMS key ARN + proof-of-possession (signed token). Also need rotation/escrow policy.

noah: From infra: two options for ingest: 1) s3 presigned upload into a customer-owned bucket + connector to index 2) POST to our /evidence API which stores into our bucket. Option 1 reduces storage liability but complicates indexing latency.

maria: For launch criteria I'd propose: (A) a stable ingest API with schema + sample client; (B) retention config per-tenant (min 90d, configurable up to X); (C) BYOK integration for at-rest encryption; (D) evidence export endpoint; (E) basic search/metadata UI and audit logs. Anything missing?

sam: AWS KMS flow I'd implement: client provides key ARN and we perform IAM role assumption + encrypt data client-side or server-side encrypt via SSE-KMS. Prototype cURL below for POST flow:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/evidence \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -F file=@audit.pdf \
  -F metadata='{"customer_id":"acme","type":"access-log"}'
```

kai: Threat model question: Do we allow us to ever see plaintext if BYOK is used? If customer keys control encryption, we should ensure we never hold plaintext keys. Also confirm whether HSM/KMS usage meets customer compliance.

amy: Contract note: add clause that customer is responsible for redaction before upload unless they opt-in to our redaction service. Also export SLA needs to be defined (e.g., data export in 7 days).

noah: SLA ask from sales: ingestion availability 99.9% and max ingest latency: 95th percentile < 5s for small files (<100KB). Bulk ingestion/replay will have different SLAs / batch windows.

maria: Can eng give rough effort/ETA? We have two paying customers asking for this in Q3.

sam: Rough scoping: API + storage plumbing + basic UI = 4-6 sprints (2 engs + 1 infra). BYOK add-on = +2 sprints for key handshake + security review. Search/index tuning + export = +2 sprints.

kai: Need security review and threat modeling session with customer to confirm boundary. Also do we need SOC2 evidence storage to be on dedicated tenant storage for some customers?

maria: Action items:
- sam: draft API contract + example client (due in 1 week)
- noah: cost model for 1/3/7 year retention + storage tiering (due EOW)
- amy/legal: draft contract clauses and export SLA language (due 5 business days)
- kai: propose BYOK handshake flow + risk doc (due in 1 week)
- ops-bot: link to runbook and create a doc stub in product/roadmap

ops-bot: Created runbook stub: https://wiki.redwood/evidence-ingest-runbook :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — please drop updates in this thread. We'll sync in product stand if anything blocks. :rocket:
